text:
alex: Quick headsup — ran a focused GPTQ bake comparing Llama-2-70b, Mistral-7b, and Qwen-7b across GPTQ/INT8/AWQ. Posting top-line evals and suggested deploy profiles.
maya: Thanks. Which evals did you run?
alex: LAMBADA (token-level), MMLU (multi-choice), TruthfulQA (open), and a custom long-context QA (16k). Also latency P50/P95 on p4d and a40-like nodes.
jordan: Nice. Any big deltas?
alex: Here are the quick numbers from the smoke run (baseline FP16 vs quantized):
```
BASLINE FP16:
Llama-2-70b: LAMBADA 68.4, MMLU 79.1, TruthfulQA 42.2
Mistral-7b:   LAMBADA 54.2, MMLU 63.8, TruthfulQA 39.3
Qwen-7b:      LAMBADA 56.0, MMLU 65.0, TruthfulQA 40.1

GPTQ (4-bit, per-channel):
Llama-2-70b: LAMBADA 66.5 (-1.9), MMLU 77.4 (-1.7)
Mistral-7b:   LAMBADA 52.8 (-1.4), MMLU 62.0 (-1.8)
Qwen-7b:      LAMBADA 55.3 (-0.7), MMLU 63.2 (-1.8)

AWQ (8-bit adaptive):
Llama-2-70b: LAMBADA 67.2 (-1.2)
Mistral-7b:   LAMBADA 53.9 (-0.3)
Qwen-7b:      LAMBADA 55.7 (-0.3)
```
bakebot: smoke run summary: artifacts uploaded, basic perf checked, no CI failures.
tess: Interesting — Llama shows small accuracy loss with GPTQ but Mistral hits a bigger hit relative; any KV cache issues for long-context?
alex: Yes — Mistral dropped ~6% absolute on our 16k QA when using GPTQ with default chunking. Suspect attention kernel/scale mismatch. Switching to per-head scaling reduced the gap to ~2%.
alex: quick quant config we used:
```
quant_config:
  method: gptq
  bits: 4
  per_channel: true
  per_head_scale: true
  symmetric: false
```
sam: @alex can you share perf numbers and recommended deploy profiles?
alex: On p4d: FP16 p50=210ms / p95=480ms for Llama-70b gen512. GPTQ 4-bit reduced memory ~2.6x and cost ~2.6x with p50 ~190ms p95 ~430ms. AWQ had similar latency to GPTQ but slightly higher memory usage.
alex: Production suggestion: GPTQ for Llama-70b on dedicated reserved pools (batch_size=1, KV cache enabled); AWQ for Mistral-7b for best quality/latency tradeoff.
jordan: Any regression hailstorms on instruction-following tests?
alex: We ran a 5k instruction eval set — found a small hallucination uptick for Qwen-7b GPTQ on multi-step math prompts. Repro steps and diffs in the gist: https://short.link/qwen-gptq-diff
maya: Can we get a canned rollout policy? Canary % and fallback model?
alex: Propose: Canary 1% -> 10% over 24h, monitor QA pass rate and perplexity. Fallback to AWQ or FP16 copy automatically if QA pass drops >3% or latency >2x baseline.
devon: I can own followup. I'll file an RFC for deploy profiles and storage of artifacts.
alex: Thanks — assigning to @devon and @jordan. I'll upload full raw eval artifacts to S3 (path: s3://redwood-ml/bakes/gptq-crossfam/4512345678/) and drop the tracker.
bakebot: artifact upload complete: s3://redwood-ml/bakes/gptq-crossfam/4512345678/ (size 3.2GB) :white_check_mark:
sam: Nice. Quick ask — add a small sample inference script and Dockerfile to the artifacts so infra can smoke-test.
alex: :thumbsup: will add. Anything else?
tess: One ask: include seed/version of model weights and quant toolchain (gptq v1.4.2).
alex: Noted. gptq v1.4.2, torch 2.2.0, quant-recipe v2026-03-10.
jordan: Cool. Thanks alex. I'll start a minimal canary tomorrow.
